description: Desired state of the AI Gateway tool servers owned by scripts/ai-gateway-release.py. Only toolServers are written; models are checked, observed/stale/deferred are reported and never modified. Secret credential header values are environment placeholders resolved at apply time only.

northwind-insurance-lookup.description: Read-only synthetic insurance policy and claim lookups (ca-insurance-lookup) exposed through the AI Gateway. The app accepts only API Management's gateway token, so the tool server calls it through apim-northwind with the insurance-agents subscription key.

northwind-insurance-knowledge.description: Foundry IQ knowledge base northwind-insurance-kb (Azure AI Search MCP endpoint) exposed through the AI Gateway, which injects a read-only Search query key.

northwind-insurance-review.description: Claim-action drafts for human review (ca-insurance-review), reached through apim-northwind with the insurance-agents subscription key. The server only accepts a draft from the application that owns the workflow (x-orders-workflow must equal workflow_id) and the AI Gateway does not forward client headers, so calls made through this tool server are rejected by design. Callers that need to draft use apim-northwind directly, as the hosted claim-action-draft agent does.

northwind-api.reason: OpenAPI facade of the Northwind REST API (23 tools). Read-only here: this unit never modifies it.
northwind-api.concern: Governance: the published operations include the HITL decide and delete operations. Approval and business execution are never agent tools, and every holder of AI Gateway Tools User or a runtime key can call every published tool. Narrow or remove this registration through a separate, reviewed change.
